facts.anchor: Dante snarled and came with me, horns appearing on his head as he sank his fangs into my throat.

facts.fact: 她想起九十多年不与人做爱的原因——性太脆弱，并疯狂想家。

facts.fact: 蜂鸣器提前响，解除禁闭。
